items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: That Moncais style. That's another good drummer.

ctx.x: Raymond used to sub, if my brother had a late show, I was making so much money I quit the office. It wasn't interesting anymore. You know I'm a leader. Because I had an outfit in Morrison's cafeteria. He used to have music there. I have outfits all over. And so if the off you had a late show, Raymond was playing at some cheap joint on Bourbon Street but he'd take his intermission at that time so he could rush in and open them with us at Cobb's. And my brother would give him a couple of dollars. And he was…
